_why: Bytes every page pays for before it can answer a tap, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs in CI after the web build. History: in Oct 2026 a 1.4 MB all-locales i18n chunk was statically imported by the root layout, and Search Console marked all 578 URLs poor on mobile INP (244 ms); splitting it into one lazy catalogue per locale (PR #6351) fixed it, and these budgets stop it creeping back. Each is the value measured on build-app/ right after that fix plus ~15% headroom (rounded up to the KB); the web build's entry/layout/catalogue/CSS chunks are near-identical (same code, only prerender differs). Bytes, raw and gzip (level 9). Raising one is fine when deliberate: edit this file (`node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs <dir> --suggest` prints measured + 15%) and say why in the PR. globalCss was LOWERED in Oct 2026 (205,645 B raw / 35,311 B gz -> 152,387 / 30,851 measured on build-app/) when the non-Latin scripts' @font-face rules moved to per-locale sheets (src/lib/fonts-<locale>.css, linked only on that locale's documents) and the reader's optional faces to fonts-reader.css (linked once chosen) — see app.css's header and $lib/fontSheets.ts; the new value is that measurement + ~15%, so a face drifting back into app.css fails here. entryClosure was LOWERED in Nov 2026 (328.6 KB raw / 123.3 KB gz -> 306.7 / 113.5 KB measured on build-app/; budget = that + ~15%) when contentNav stopped importing $lib/audienceHub (the hub config moved to $lib/audienceHubs) and SiteFooter began importing $lib/currentBook only when it can show a resume; together they had pulled library-public, seo, resumeBooks and resumeItems into every page. globalCss LOWERED again in Nov 2026 (151.6 KB raw / 30.9 KB gz -> 138.2 / 28.0 measured on build-app/) when the nine library palettes moved to static/palettes.css, linked only for a reader with a palette (paletteSheet.test.ts); budget = that + ~15%. largestCatalogue RAISED in Nov 2026 (177 -> 182 KB raw, 37 -> 38 KB gz): the SEO work added two pages of reader-facing prose to every locale catalogue, the /editorial "How we publish" policy and the home-page Q&A, pushing Hindi (the largest, Devanagari is 3 bytes a letter in UTF-8) to 177.9 KB raw / 37.1 KB gz. About 1 KB raw and 0.1 KB gz per page, which a citable editorial policy and FAQ markup are worth. largestCatalogue RAISED again in Nov 2026 (182 -> 184 KB raw, 38 -> 39 KB gz): the /bible canon strip's quick filters (five short labels) took Hindi to 182.1 KB raw / 37.9 KB gz — the last raise had left no headroom, so the next string anywhere would have tripped it; 2 KB raw / 1 KB gz is that headroom back. largestCatalogue RAISED again in Nov 2026 (184 -> 190 KB raw, 39 -> 40 KB gz): the page-design round (Authors, Articles, Quotes, Young Readers, Series, Glossary, Originals) added about forty short labels and the Originals "Why we write" note to every catalogue, taking Hindi to 185.0 KB raw / 38.6 KB gz with the Originals note still to land; 190 / 40 holds those and leaves ~3 KB raw of headroom. entryClosure RAISED in Nov 2026 (353 -> 361 KB raw, 131 -> 136 KB gz): Svelte 5.57.3 -> 5.59.1 (Dependabot frontend group) grew the runtime every page loads by 11.4 KB raw / 4.3 KB gz, measured on build-app/ with and without only that bump (345.2 / 129.4 KB -> 356.6 / 133.7 KB); the rest of the group adds nothing to it (Sentry loads lazily in hooks.client.ts). Staying on an old Svelte is not a fix, so the budget takes the runtime plus ~2 KB gz of headroom, not the usual +15%.
_whyAppBundle: appBundle: the whole build-app/ folder the phone apps ship (every file, raw bytes), checked by scripts/build-app.mjs at the end of `npm run app:build`. Before Oct 2026 the app bundled all of static/ (245 MB: covers, share cards, portraits); covers, portraits, illustrations, og/ and pdfs/ now load from the website ($lib/assetUrl, app-assets.js) and the .woff font fallbacks are dropped, leaving 19.5 MB — nearly all webfonts (woff2) and JS. Budget = that + ~15%, rounded to the MB. A store app should stay small; raise it only deliberately, with the reason in the PR. Nov 2026 (Japanese): 24 -> 38 MB. The Noto Serif/Sans JP woff2 slices (400 + 700, ~14 MB) brought the bundle to 33.6 MB; they ship in the app for the reason the Korean ones do, so a Japanese book reads offline in its own face rather than the phone's. Budget = 33.6 MB + ~15%, rounded to the MB.
